title: The look-alike card
question: Can one page show Caplet each fact in the final IPS beside the false look-alike a rewrite lands on, so they can reword freely without landing on one, and does it catch the breaks real rewrites make? (round 8 beat 5; the Kitchen's request; plus the Library's seed, L-18: does every cheque hold when the 2028 deposit falls short in the same downturn?)
serves: North star 3 (extraordinary: a hospital's look-alike-drug trick turned on our own IPS) and 4 (investing knowledge kept true through Caplet's rewrite); Wharton: Investment Strategy and Client Knowledge (every fact stays true), Portfolio Analysis (L-18, funding reliability)

rounds.name: Kai builds the card and roasts L-18 blind; Jun writes three rewrites with no card; Amara seals her judging sheet
Jun counts what his rewrites broke and what the card caught; Amara judges the card cold
Kai lands it; a held-out test by two strangers; Kai's last fixes

seeds: Does a real Caplet student, rewriting on Thursday, keep the 'for' (or 'before') in 'one redeemed for each January' with the card beside them? (Archive, Fri 6 Nov: compare Caplet's submitted text with the card)
Re-run L-18's deposit break point on the 6 Nov close before the Final Report quotes it (Genius Lab, from Sat 7 Nov)
essence: We built a one-page check sheet for tomorrow's rewrite: each fact in the final IPS beside the false version a rewrite tends to land on, with the part that differs in capitals, the way hospitals label look-alike medicines.

Its first version caught only one of the seven mistakes three test rewrites made, so we rebuilt it; the new one caught every mistake in two rewrites it had never seen. All five test rewrites made the same slip: 'one redeemed for each January' lost its 'for', and nothing pays out in a January.

We also tested the IPS's warning that her income can dry up when shares fall: with half the 2028 deposit in that kind of downturn, every cheque is still paid in 9,996 futures in 10,000 (our model); with no deposit at all, only about 1 in 5.
decided: L-19 the look-alike card: ADOPT for Caplet's rewrite (v1 1 of 7; v3 10 rows, one page; held-out v2 2 of 2, 0 false alarms)
IPS offer: P2 'one redeemed for each January' -> 'one redeemed before each January' (+0, 493 strict)
L-18 the same downturn: ADOPT for the Final Report (deposit halved 99.96%, shares halved too 99.96%, $50k 96.00%, none 18.46%; MODEL); Kai's sealed 94% was too gloomy
The Library's 'no KWN-w in S9': CORD, the row exists (98.28%)
